name: cavemio-popover
title: Popover
description: A small panel that belongs to a button: it rises off the trigger from the nearest point, flips to fit, and hands focus to what is inside.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Placement, presence and dismissal live in floating.ts, shared by tooltip, popover, dropdown and context menus: they all flip, shift, enter and leave the same way.
- The panel is role="dialog"; the trigger gets aria-haspopup and aria-expanded.
- Reduced motion: it fades.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.
